div.head: Excom I 6.3
div.ab: Iubet ergo Dominus, ut frater, id est Christianus in nos peccans, primo secrete corripiatur, deinde cum testibus redarguatur, nouissime in conuentu æcclesiæ publice conueniatur.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 432 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: The Lord therefore commands that a brother, that is a Christian, who sins against us, be first rebuked in secret, then reproved before witnesses, and lastly be publicly called to account in the assembly of the church.
